def _build_pairlist_data(
    i_pairs: torch.Tensor,
    j_pairs: torch.Tensor,
    r_ij: torch.Tensor,
    d_ij: torch.Tensor,
    in_cutoff: torch.Tensor,
    only_unique_pairs: bool,
    device: torch.device,
    dtype: torch.dtype,
) -> PairlistData:
    """
    Assemble a PairlistData object from the pairs that fall within the cutoff.

    When ``only_unique_pairs`` is True, only the (i, j) pairs generated from the
    upper triangle of the meshgrid are returned. When False, the non-unique
    pairs are simply the (i, j) pairs together with their (j, i) mirror, where
    the displacement vector sign is flipped for the mirrored half.

    Parameters
    ----------
    i_pairs, j_pairs : torch.Tensor
        The i and j atom indices of the candidate pairs.
    r_ij, d_ij : torch.Tensor
        Displacement vectors and distances for the candidate pairs.
    in_cutoff : torch.Tensor
        Boolean mask selecting the pairs within the cutoff.
    only_unique_pairs : bool
        Whether to return only unique pairs.
    device : torch.device
        Device on which to allocate the output tensors.
    dtype : torch.dtype
        Floating point dtype for r_ij and d_ij outputs.

    Returns
    -------
    PairlistData
    """
    total_pairs = in_cutoff.sum()

    i_in_cutoff = i_pairs[in_cutoff]
    j_in_cutoff = j_pairs[in_cutoff]

    if only_unique_pairs:
        # using this instead of torch.stack to ensure that if we only have a
        # single pair we don't run into an issue with tensor shapes.
        pairs = torch.zeros(2, total_pairs, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
        pairs[0] = i_in_cutoff
        pairs[1] = j_in_cutoff

        return PairlistData(
            pair_indices=pairs,
            d_ij=d_ij[in_cutoff],
            r_ij=r_ij[in_cutoff],
        )

    r_ij_full = torch.zeros(total_pairs * 2, 3, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    d_ij_full = torch.zeros(total_pairs * 2, 1, dtype=dtype, device=device)

    r_ij_in_cutoff = r_ij[in_cutoff]
    # i, j pairs
    r_ij_full[0:total_pairs] = r_ij_in_cutoff
    # j, i pairs, require we swap the sign
    r_ij_full[total_pairs : 2 * total_pairs] = -r_ij_in_cutoff

    d_ij_in_cutoff = d_ij[in_cutoff]
    d_ij_full[0:total_pairs] = d_ij_in_cutoff
    d_ij_full[total_pairs : 2 * total_pairs] = d_ij_in_cutoff

    pairs = torch.zeros(2, total_pairs * 2, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
    pairs[0][0:total_pairs] = i_in_cutoff
    pairs[1][0:total_pairs] = j_in_cutoff
    pairs[0][total_pairs : 2 * total_pairs] = j_in_cutoff
    pairs[1][total_pairs : 2 * total_pairs] = i_in_cutoff

    return PairlistData(
        pair_indices=pairs,
        d_ij=d_ij_full,
        r_ij=r_ij_full,
    )
